Here’s exactly what you get for $99 / month (first 2 months):  

• A six‑week, step‑by‑step Algebra II review — new video lesson + practice set each day.

• Instant feedback on every problem so she can self‑correct.  
• 24/7 access from any device, start within 3 days of sign‑up.  

There’s **no contract** and **no cancellation fee**—you can stop anytime from the account page and you won’t be billed after the current month.  

Refunds: only the first month is refundable (full refund if you request within 7 days and she’s completed fewer than one lesson). After that, you keep access for the month you’ve paid.  

The $99 rate ends Dec 20, and spots fill fast for the six‑week track. Let’s lock her in now so she can start catching up today—just visit pinecrestlabs.example/enroll and choose the Final Prep plan. Any other worries I can clear up?

If she's not improving after a month, I'd be stuck with the rest of it. I'm going to think it over and talk to my daughter before deciding anything.
